# Koi-Koi Play Pal

> Play the classic Japanese Hanafuda card game Koi-Koi in your browser, with beautiful ukiyo-e cards and AI opponents.

Koi-Koi Play Pal is a browser-based implementation of the traditional Japanese flower-card game Hanafuda. It includes the full 48-card deck, three AI difficulty levels, an interactive card gallery, and learnable rules with all 12 yaku scoring combinations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, hero, rules, card gallery, and the Koi-Koi game itself.
- [Design System](/design-system): Color tokens, typography, components, and theme reference.
